packageRules.description: Group Loki + Alloy (both Grafana, often released together)
Group the Flux distribution and the operator that installs it
Talos version bumps need manual review + per-node rollout
prBodyNotes: **Merging this does not upgrade anything.** Rollout is manual: `talos/genconfig.sh`, then `talosctl upgrade` node by node (oak, maple, pine).

On a minor bump, check the [Talos support matrix](https://www.talos.dev/latest/introduction/support-matrix/) and raise the `kubernetes/kubernetes` `allowedVersions` ceiling in `renovate.json` to match.

packageRules.description: K8s ceiling from the Talos support matrix (Talos 1.14 supports K8s <= 1.37). Raise this after a Talos minor upgrade, not before.
K8s bumps need a manual rollout. Patch and minor updates come as separate PRs, so a pending minor does not hide patches for the running one.
prBodyNotes: **Merging this does not upgrade anything.** Rollout is manual: `talosctl upgrade-k8s`. Merge it on the day you run the rollout: `talos/genconfig.sh` reads `KUBERNETES_VERSION`, so each config you render after the merge carries the new version.

packageRules.description: Group the external-dns chart with the external-dns GitRepository tag that supplies the DNSEndpoint CRD (chart 1.x.0 ships app v0.x.0; the chart usually trails the tag by days, so a grouped PR may carry the tag alone)
Group the Garage GitRepository tag (the chart is script/helm/garage at that tag) with the Garage image
Gateway API CRDs come straight from the upstream repo via the gateway-api GitRepository
prBodyNotes: Merging applies the new CRD schemas directly — Flux fetches the tag and reconciles `config/crd`.
Before merging a minor: confirm the installed Cilium supports this Gateway API version (Cilium docs → Gateway API support).
